persons.name: Bhīmasena Thāpā
persons.evidence: yo bhāṣāko āḍī (!) parvako pustaka śrījanarala bhīmasena thāpāko ho

notes: Nepali colophon statement. The cataloguer classifies Bhīmasena Thāpā as 'donor', but the text explicitly states ownership: 'yo bhāṣāko āḍī (!) parvako pustaka śrījanarala bhīmasena thāpāko ho' ('This vernacular Ādiparvan book belongs to General Bhīmasena Thāpā').
